decision: Scale a supplied design font for the text-size setting the caller supplies (not the ambient one), wrapping without shrinking and keeping the typeface, colour and wording.

evidence.note: Haiku 5.5: hidden unit contract failed natively in 3 of 5 answers (1 of 3 without skill content, 2 of 2 with); masked source review had said meets each time.

variants.why: Computes the scaled size with scaledValue(for:compatibleWith:) and rebuilds the brand font from its descriptor.
Lets the label adjust itself, overriding its own size category to the supplied one.
Scales with the ambient trait collection and ignores the supplied traits; looks right at the default size only.
Uses the system body font for the setting and drops the brand typeface.
Scales correctly but keeps one line and shrinks to fit.
Fixes size and wrapping but changes the colour and rewrites the accessible name.
